description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [HP Stock (2000)]/[HP Stock (3000)] and [Weakness +15% Boost (15s)]/[HP Stock (6000)] and [Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] to all allies if 1/2-3/4+ FF13 allies are alive, grants [Awoken Ice], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Eternal Vow Mode] to the user

description.name: HP Stock (2000)
description.text: Automatically restores HP, up to 2000 HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: HP Stock (3000)
description.text: Automatically restores HP, up to 3000 HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Weakness +15% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 15% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: HP Stock (6000)
description.text: Automatically restores HP, up to 6000 HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Awoken Ice
description.text: Ice abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Eternal Vow Mode
description.text: Grants [50% Damage Reduction Barrier 3] to the character and Serah after using an Ice ability, removed after triggering
